G3 A text field for “Search for” with a hidden label
View code 
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Search with Hidden Label</title>
  <style>
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form role="search" action="/search" method="get">
    <label class="sr-only" for="search-field">Search for</label>
    <input
      type="search"
      id="search-field"
      name="q"
      placeholder="Search…"
      aria-label="Search for"
    />
    <button type="submit">Search</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

G5 Accessible text field for “Search for” with a hidden label
View code 
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Accessible Search Field</title>
  <style>
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form role="search" action="/search" method="get">
    <label class="sr-only" for="search">Search for</label>
    <input
      id="search"
      name="q"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Search for..."
      required
      aria-describedby="search-help"
    />
    <span id="search-help" class="sr-only">Enter the term you want to find.</span>
    <button type="submit">Search</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
